slides.title: Flights and buses to Mekelle are back
slides.body: What families with loved ones in Tigray should know

slides.title: Flights resumed Oct 11
slides.body: Ethiopian Airlines restarted Addis Ababa–Mekelle flights, bne IntelliNews and the US Embassy reported. Flights to Axum and Shire remain suspended.

slides.title: Buses running again
slides.body: DW reported a bus operator restarted Addis Ababa–Mekelle trips, with seats through Thursday sold out. Transport also resumed on the Mekelle–Semera road.

slides.title: Still not safe, embassies warn
slides.body: The US Embassy says it cannot guarantee safety on the road and advises traveling in groups. The US and UK still advise against travel to Tigray.

slides.title: Check before you travel. Stay safe.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Sources: bne IntelliNews, Oct 12; DW, Oct 14; US Embassy alert, Oct 12, 2026 (via Mereja)
